## Publication Information

**Date:** 1881

**Genre:** Fiction

**Publisher:** Walter Smith (late Mozley), 34 King Street, Covent Garden

**Notes:** The stories are ‘Cheap Jack’,  ‘Frank’s Debt’,  ‘Curiosity Trap’,  ‘Drumbledore Bill’ and ‘Wolf’.
